release_notes: Feature release: PWA landings (store-style constructor, funnel beacons, service-worker push subscription with self-heal, direct domain binding), web push campaigns on your own base (self-hosted VAPID, subscriber list with test send, manual & event messages, segments, macros, cron-driven queue) and a content gallery (folders, drag-and-drop upload, MediaPicker with cropping). Also: push delivery hardened by live-device diagnostics (four crypto-layer fixes), landing→offer {subid} fix, service worker on bound domains, panel session lifetime, friendlier 'database is locked' handling. New guides: docs/pwa-push.md, docs/content-gallery.md.
